title: Skilled Role in Your Trade (after B.Voc)

value.body: A B.Voc combines general education with hands-on training in one sector — such as retail, healthcare, IT, hospitality, automobile, media or agriculture — aligned to the National Skills Qualifications Framework (NSQF). Graduates usually start as technicians, associates or executives in that sector and grow through experience and certifications.

items.label: Course length
items.note: Exit options: diploma after 1 year, advanced diploma after 2

value.title: How you get in
value.body: A B.Voc in the sector (Class 12 is the entry requirement). Jobs come through campus placement, the college's industry partners, apprenticeships and direct applications; sector skill council certifications can add to the degree.

value.title: At a glance
items: Starting roles are usually hands-on — technician, associate or executive — in the trained sector.
Growth comes through experience, added certifications and supervisory responsibility.
Employer familiarity with the B.Voc varies, so demonstrable practical skills help.
An M.Voc or other postgraduate study is possible later.
